# Face fixtures

`nasa-portrait.jpg`: official NASA portrait of astronaut Sally Ride (1984),
500×625 thumbnail from Wikimedia Commons
(`File:Sally_Ride_(1984).jpg`). **Public domain**: a work of the US federal
government (NASA), as recorded on the file page's licence metadata.

Used only to test that face detection finds a real face. Never uploaded
anywhere, and not demo data.
